purpose: Use one same-canonical hourly RRULE as bounded cold rescue and fast continuation, with an experimental predictive-prearm mode to hide normal scheduler latency under predecessor useful work.
canonical_invariant: Never create a replacement canonical merely to continue this actor. Mutate only the verified canonical identified by fresh durable state.

provisional_arm.when: Immediately after minimum stale-wake/fence/authority validation and before full restore or substantive work.
provisional_arm.reason: If the active turn dies before normal close, the same canonical retains a bounded cold-rescue opportunity.
provisional_arm.mutation_failure: Retry once when safe. If an older verified future continuation remains alive, enter DEGRADED_CONTINUATION and continue only within its safety envelope; otherwise fail closed before substantive side effects.

work.rule: Perform sustained useful authorized work. Ten minutes is the bounded planning target.
work.checkpoint_rule: Persist enough durable progress that a cold successor can resume without chat context.
work.collision_rule: If useful work remains and provisional due approaches too closely, extend the provisional DTSTART before collision, then verify.

predictive_prearm_canary.goal: Absorb scheduler delivery latency while predecessor is still doing useful work so post-close non-useful gap can fit the P0 budget.
predictive_prearm_canary.arm_timing: Near the end of the bounded turn after a fresh checkpoint, early enough that scheduler latency may overlap remaining predecessor work.
predictive_prearm_canary.predecessor_rule: Continue useful work through the bounded close; predictive arm is not permission to idle or return early.
predictive_prearm_canary.successor_rule: Apply scheduler fence and control/handoff-recovery.v1.json PREDICTIVE_PREARM_OVERLAP. While predecessor is fresh/conflicting, do not claim substantive authority or duplicate side effects.
predictive_prearm_canary.promotion_rule: At least two safe same-canonical predictive-prearm handoffs with no duplicate substantive side effect or rollback and observed post-close gap <=42 seconds, followed by a valid fixed 900-second utilization window.
predictive_prearm_canary.rollback_rule: Any unsafe overlap, duplicate side effect, schedule rollback, or missed successor restores normal_final_rearm before further promotion.

evidence_basis.observed_sequence: Stage 1 woke, mutated the same canonical hourly RRULE DTSTART to actual wake +2m, persisted Stage 2 prompt, then Stage 2 executed and the same canary was disabled.

rollback: If live production evidence shows early duplicate substantive ownership, missed continuation, schedule rollback, or unsafe overlap, preserve the canonical and restore the last verified slower cadence before further substantive work.
